Meta.siteTitle: João Vargas Tours | Taxi, tours and levadas from Calheta, Madeira
Meta.siteDescription: Taxi tours, levada walks and transfers to and from Calheta, Madeira, with João, a local taxi driver. Prices per taxi. Message on WhatsApp or call.

Footer.tagline: Private tours and transfers in Madeira with a local driver.

hero.imageAlt: Aerial view of Calheta on Madeira's south-west coast, with houses on the green hillside, the sandy beach, the breakwaters and the marina
hero.title: Tours and taxi from Calheta
hero.subtitle: João lives in Calheta, 5 minutes from the Saccharum and Calheta Beach hotels. Island tours, levada walks and transfers with a local taxi driver: message him on WhatsApp or give him a call.

services.title: Tours from Calheta
services.intro: Private trips at your own pace, just for your group, starting at your hotel in Calheta. Pick a tour and send João the message on WhatsApp.

about.title: Meet João
about.imageAlt: João Vargas, taxi driver from Calheta, smiling in a white shirt
about.text1: João is from Calheta and lives just 5 minutes from the Calheta Beach and Saccharum hotels. He is close by to pick you up at your hotel at the time you agree.
about.text2: He knows Calheta and the whole island well: the quiet viewpoints, the best times to avoid the crowds and where to stop for a good lunch.

taxi.title: João's taxi
taxi.intro: A yellow Calheta taxi, licence 0724, with room for up to 6 passengers and their luggage.

alt.joao: João Vargas standing beside his yellow taxi, licence 0724 Calheta
alt.side: Side view of João's yellow taxi with a blue stripe, parked in front of banana trees
alt.front: João's yellow taxi seen from the front, with the taxi sign on the roof
alt.door: Close-up of the taxi door with the sign Taxi 0724 Calheta

local.title: Knows Calheta
local.text: Born and living in Calheta. He knows every road, beach and viewpoint on the west coast, and the rest of the island.

nearby.title: 5 minutes from your hotel
nearby.text: He lives just 5 minutes from the Calheta Beach and Saccharum hotels, so pick-up is quick and on time.

flexible.title: Flexible
flexible.text: You choose the time and the pace. Change the route or stay longer where you like it.

tours.title: Taxi tours from Calheta
tours.description: Private taxi tours of Madeira starting in Calheta: North Tour, Middle Tour, East Tour and levada walks. Prices per taxi.
tours.intro: Every tour starts and ends in Calheta. Price per taxi, one way or return. Pick one and ask for it on WhatsApp.
tours.levadasIntro: João takes you to the start of the trail and, on return trips, collects you at the end.

transfers.description: Taxi from Calheta to Madeira airport, Funchal centre and Porto Moniz. Prices per taxi.
transfers.intro: Private rides to and from Calheta. One taxi, up to 6 passengers.
